work.title: Über eine Arbeit des im Kriege gefallenen K. Hentzelt zur Eliminationstheorie
work.author: Emmy Noether

lane.scope_note: Ordinary English translation synchronized to current German authority and the primary printed page.

concept.intended_sense: the final one-variable factor and the congruence relation closing Noether's unique resultant form for the ideal M
excluded_senses: a final factor indexed by m
a target-language terminology choice independent of the printed formula

target.audience: scholarly readers of Noether and elimination theory

candidates.definition_or_gloss: the endpoint printed on the original page and preserved in R823
the stale RA10 formula with the wrong superscript and relation

support.context_window: The complete one-line resultant display visibly ends with superscript n and a congruence sign.

weight_semantics.notes: Canonical formula witness; not a target-language-use statistic.

support.context_window: The regression ledger explicitly rejects both equality and superscript m.

weight_semantics.notes: Dependent audit of the same GDZ root witness; it adds no source breadth.

candidate.context_window: RA10 supplies the inherited English prose but has two source-incompatible formula readings.

weight_semantics.notes: Same-project inherited candidate; not independent source or target evidence.

weight_semantics.notes: Typed source-mismatch rejection, not negative probability.

branch_model.independence_note: The decision is source-locked mathematical notation. The original GDZ page is the German root witness; R366, R823, and package extracts are dependent descendants. RA10 is one inherited English candidate cohort.

sense.notes: The complete resultant sentence and display fix the role of the final factor.

false_friend.notes: The selected locus is mathematical notation.

dominance.notes: The German primary source governs the formula; no English-usage claim is made.

register.notes: Formula notation is preserved while surrounding prose is ordinary specialist English.

script.notes: The final factor, superscript, congruence, and ideal glyph rendered correctly.

source_scarcity.notes: One primary page plus dependent audits establish the source reading; dependent derivatives are not counted as breadth.

source_floor.evidence_or_reason: The complete native 600 ppi GDZ page and R823 span agree; 600 ppi remains below the project preference.

context_review.evidence_or_reason: The complete contribution and full resultant display were reviewed.

adverse_review.evidence_or_reason: The inherited superscript and equality are recorded and rejected.

branch_or_cohort_review.evidence_or_reason: The original page is separated from its dependent audits and the RA10 translation cohort.

script_policy.evidence_or_reason: The source-locked formula renders legibly and without overflow.

internal_qa.evidence_or_reason: Two builds, log scan, text extraction, CSV parsing/previews, and complete-page visual inspection passed.

human_comprehension.evidence_or_reason: No controlled human-comprehension test has been run.

decision.rationale: The original JDMV page visibly prints superscript n and a congruence sign, the dependent R366 audit records both as regression traps, and the current R823 authority preserves them. The inherited RA10 superscript m and equality are therefore source errors, not permissible English variants.
decision.reviewer_question: Should the eventual cumulative reader add a non-intrusive editorial note explaining the historical congruence notation 0(M)?

invariants.must_preserve: The final factor is R^(n)(x_n) and the relation to 0(M) is congruence, not equality.
invariants.may_change: Spacing around factors and the congruence sign.
invariants.test: Compare the complete GDZ page, R366 regression ledger, R823 extract, PDF text, and render.

invariants.must_preserve: The contribution begins with the 11th Session block and ends after the norm sentence, excluding adjacent material.
invariants.may_change: Standalone page layout and editorial citation wrapper styling.
invariants.test: Source-keyed structural checklist against GDZ p. 101 and the R823 Paper 19 boundary.

invariants.must_preserve: Readable one-page PDF with the complete one-line resultant display and no diagnostic failures.
invariants.test: Two pdflatex passes, log scan, text extraction, and complete rendered-page inspection.

provenance.notes: No scalar readiness, auto-promotion, external review, or human-comprehension claim is made.
